Microphone Filters

Settings

Microphones, speakers, and levels are remembered on this computer.

Keyboard & MIDI

Only assigned shortcuts are registered. Quiet Lab must remain open. Reserved or occupied shortcuts are reported rather than overridden.

Select your controller, then use Learn MIDI on a sound pad. Note-on and controller (CC) presses are supported; release messages do not play clips.
